references.text: Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord and does not turn to the proud or those who deal in falsehood
The Lord, God of hosts, blessed is the man who trusts in you
Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, whose trust is the Lord

While he was saying this, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said to him, "Blessed is the womb that bore you and the breasts at which you nursed." But he said, "Yes, rather blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it."
